Season couldn't move the boulder by pushing harder, so he stood steady instead, and the mountain moved for him ⛰️

Season is the bright Yang spirit, and when he felt the deep strength of the rock he became Yang Earth: the mountain itself. Wu Earth doesn't rush or bend with every wind. It stays calm, solid and dependable, the kind of ground everyone else can stand on, and it moves only when the time is right. In people, it is the loyal, patient, protective side: the one who keeps their promises, stays calm in a crisis and quietly holds everything together. Steady beats strong.

Who is the mountain in your life, the one you can always count on? Tag them below 👇
